question: Does the bridge in this directory still produce the observations of a run recorded before the full action interface was added?
method: The action windows of one recorded run were replayed through the bridge with no model. Every observation line was compared byte for byte with the recording.

recording.made: 2026-11-18 by the earlier bridge, with a harness outside this pull request choosing the windows

limits: The recording uses six of the actions. New actions are covered by action-probes.json. Agreement was measured on one machine with Mesa software rendering.
